qualification.details: Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences): Graduate degree in Life Sciences or an allied basic-science discipline relevant to biomedical research. At least one year of relevant experience in biomedical, laboratory, public-health, clinical, or health-research work is desirable. Young Professional-II (Information Technology): Postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, or Computer Graphics. Minimum of three years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences): Graduate degree in Life Sciences or an allied basic-science discipline relevant to biomedical research. At least one year of relevant experience in biomedical, laboratory, public-health, clinical, or health-research work is desirable. Young Professional-II (Information Technology): Postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, or Computer Graphics. Minimum of three years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICMR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) for the ICMR TB Research Accelerator on a temporary contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this ICMR notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the positions of Young Professional-I and Young Professional-II under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts offered in ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences) and Young Professional-II (Information Technology) under the ICMR TB Research Accelerator project.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date and time for the receipt of applications via email is 21 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they submit before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for ICMR Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through email. Candidates need to send their filled applications and supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences) must possess a graduate degree in Life Sciences or an allied basic-science discipline relevant to biomedical research.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Young Professional-II (Information Technology) must have a postgraduate degree in Computer Applications, IT, Computer Science, AI, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, or Computer Graphics with at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 35,000/- for Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences) and Rs. 42,000/- for Young Professional-II (Information Technology).

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for ICMR Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years for Young Professional-I and 35 years for Young Professional-II, with age relaxation applicable as per rules.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes screening against eligibility criteria, followed by a written test, skill test, or assignment where necessary, and an interview for shortlisted candidates.
